facts.statement: AirPods Pro 2 USB-C earbuds and case have an IP54 rating.
AirPods Pro 2 Lightning earbuds and case have an IPX4 rating.
Sony WF-1000XM5 earbuds have IPX4-equivalent splash protection.
The WF-1000XM5 charging case is not water resistant.
Neither specified earbud model is intended for swimming or immersion.
S8 Pro Ultra dock placement requires at least 0.7 m of free space in front.
Dock placement requires at least 0.5 m of free space above.
The S8 Pro Ultra supports only 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi.
The owner must empty and clean the dirty-water tank as needed.
Apple Watch Series 2 and later have a 50 m water-resistance rating.
Apple Watch Ultra and later have a 100 m water-resistance rating.
Series 2 and later support shallow-water swimming; that rating does not authorize scuba diving.
Ultra models support recreational scuba diving to 40 m; the rating is not the permitted diving depth.
